Selection needs more than O(1) comparisons per element, so the work has to sit either in a body or in a dynamic number of top-level stages; inside a body the smallest insert is a consed comparison quotation plus a filter plus the plumbing to keep two copies of the accumulator, which cannot reach 8 atoms, and consing the data list into a map body already costs one atom per element.
